pages.title: Wapiti
pages.text: The wapiti ($(o)Cervus canadensis$()), also called the elk in North America, is one of the largest deer, found in the forests and grasslands of North America and Central and East Asia.$(br2)During the autumn rut, bulls produce a loud, high-pitched call known as bugling to attract cows and challenge rivals.$(br2)Wapiti gather in large herds, especially in winter, and graze on grasses, sedges and shrubs.
